title: Grok vs. Dot vs. Muse vs. Claude Duet: which one crushes the competition?
text: Grok vs. Dot vs. Muse vs. Claude Duet: which one crushes the competition? Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 5 Grok vs. Dot vs. Muse vs. Claude Duet: which one crushes the competition? 🎙️ I ranked Grok Bot, Dot, Muse, and Claude Duet across 9 real tasks—and the scores told me which agent runs my work and which runs my life Claire Vo Oct 28, 2026 5 Share Transcript I have personal-agent fatigue, so I ran the first How I AI personal-agent benchmark: Grok Bot, Dot, Muse, and Claude Duet across nine real tasks, from a Slack reply and a Sentry bug to a Figma thumbnail, inbox triage, a family newspaper, physics homework for a fourth grader, shoe shopping, and a ChatPRD launch video. I used computer use to operate them: Claude ran Dot, Codex ran the rest and scored the results live. Here’s the scoreboard—and which agent I’d actually trust for work vs. life. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts Brought to you by: WorkOS —Make your app enterprise-ready, with SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and more Firecrawl —Give your AI agents web data and beyond In this episode, we cover: ( 00:00 ) Introduction ( 02:13 ) The personal-agent benchmark setup ( 05:00 ) The nine tasks and the prompts I used ( 07:20 ) Scoreboard overview ( 10:06 ) Task 1: Draft a Slack reply as me ( 11:39 ) Task 2: Cut a short-form video from raw Dropbox footage ( 14:56 ) Task 3: Fix a bug from Sentry ( 17:30 ) Task 4: Build a How I AI thumbnail in Figma ( 19:25 ) Task 5: Triage my inbox for to-dos ( 21:06 ) Task 6: Build a family newspaper ( 23:30 ) Task 7: Explain a physics homework question to a fourth grader ( 24:54 ) Task 8: Shop for shoes ( 26:46 ) Task 9: Make a ChatPRD Product Intelligence launch video ( 30:01 ) Final scores ( 32:38 ) My takeaways Tools referenced: • Grok Bot: https://x.ai/bot • Dot: https://chatgpt.com/features/dots/ • Meta Muse: https://ai.meta.com/muse/ • Claude Duet: https://claude.com/product/claude-duet • Codex: https://openai.com/codex • ElevenLabs: https://elevenlabs.io/ • Figma: https://www.figma.com/ • Sentry: https://sentry.io/ • Linear: https://linear.app/ • Dropbox: https://www.dropbox.com/ Where to find Claire Vo: ChatPRD: https://www.chatprd.ai/ Website: https://clairevo.com/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/clairevo/ X: https://x.com/clairevo Production and marketing by https://penname.co/ .
